mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat into intestinal cells, its packaging as chylomicrons, and its entry into lymph made its distinct route concrete. The picture descriptions and brief explanation connect the stages without assuming familiarity with chylomicrons.

leastWorthwhile.text: The glucose and amino-acid crossings were repetitive and showed no transport mechanisms; the planned pictures simply put each nutrient across a cell into a capillary.

surprise.text: Fat had to enter intestinal cells before packaging, and the villus was also required as the station for packaging and lymph entry.

arbitrary.text: Combining chylomicrons directly with the lacteal entrance seemed physically sensible, but the operation required the villus as the partner. Compatibility feedback resolved it automatically.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: comparing the fat and nutrient routes was interesting, although I would want more explanation of transport mechanisms and terms such as portal blood.
